target.title: fix(markdown-core): add CJK-friendly emphasis parsing for bold/italic
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves When agent output contains `**标签：**正文` (CJK punctuation immediately inside closing `**`), Telegram renders literal `**` instead of bold. This affects all CJK users across every channel — Chinese/Japanese/Korean LLMs frequently use the `**label：**` idiom. The root cause is markdown-it v14.3.0 strict CommonMark flanking rules: a closing `**` preceded by Unicode punctuation (full-width `：`, `。`, `、`) must be followed by whitespace/punctuation to be right-flanking. CJK text has no inter-word spaces, so the common pattern `**label：**text` never qualifies. Fixes #101120. ## Root Cause / Fix **Root cause**: `markdown-it`'s `scanDelims` in the inline state classifies CJK punctuation (Unicode category P) as punctuation, setting `right_flanking=false` for `*` delimiters adjacent to them. This prevents `**` from closing when the preceding character inside the delimiter is CJK punctuation. **Fix**: Wire `markdown-it-cjk-friendly` (v2.0.2, MIT, 6k weekly downloads, adopted by VitePress 2.x) into `createMarkdownIt` in `packages/markdown-core/src/ir.ts`. The plugin overrides `scanDelims` to recognize CJK characters (via East Asian Width) as valid flanking triggers. This is a **shared/core fix** — all channels (Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.) benefit because they all consume the same markdown-core IR pipeline. **Files changed**: 3 files, +4 lines (ir.ts +2, package.json +1, lockfile) ## Evidence ### Before/After (CJK bold rendering) | Input | Before | After | |-------|--------|-------| | `**标题：**正文` | `**标题：**正文` ✗ | `标题：正文` ✅ | | `**粗体：**内容` | `**粗体：**内容` ✗ | `粗体：内容` ✅ | | `**标签。**后续` | `**标签。**后续` ✗ | `标签。后续` ✅ | | `边界：**社区显示：**Fable 与 **有效**。` | `边界：**社区显示：**Fable 与 有效。` | `边界：社区显示：Fable 与 有效。` | ### Regression: non-CJK bold (must not change) ``` ✅ **hello** world => hello world ✅ **foo** and **bar** => foo and bar ✅ this is **bold** text => this is bold text ✅ *italic* and **bold** => italic and bold 4/4 passed — non-CJK emphasis unchanged ``` ### Test Results ``` packages/markdown-core: Test Files 12 passed Tests 96 passed extensions/telegram: Test Files 1 passed Tests 67 passed ``` ### Autoreview ``` autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported overall: patch is correct (0.95) ``` ### oxfmt / oxlint - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check` — ✅ - `pnpm exec oxlint` — ✅ - `git diff --check` — ✅ ## Change Type / Scope / Security Impact - **Type**: fix - **Scope**: `packages/markdown-core` (shared parser, affects all channels) - **Files**: 3 files (ir.ts +2 lines, package.json +1 dep, lockfile) - **Dependency**: `markdown-it-cjk-friendly@2.0.2` — MIT license, 1 sub-dependency (`get-east-asian-width`), no security advisories - **Security**: No security impact - **Backward compatibility**: Non-CJK emphasis behavior unchanged (4/4 regression tests pass)
